title: BNPL Diamond: Integrating with Accounting Tools and Supported Platforms
summary: BNPL Diamond offers API integration for eligible customers with direct connections to QUICKBOOKS, XERO, SAP, and NETSUITE. It provides setup steps (authorize API access and map accounts for principal, repayments, and adjustments) and syncs plan creation/schedules, repayment entries/adjustments, and reconciled statuses; it also covers troubleshooting when API is NONE or permissions/authentication/posting errors occur.
faqs: Which accounting platforms are supported for BNPL Diamond API integration?
